title: chenopodium latifolium subsp. rectum
intro: Chenopodium latifolium subsp. rectum, commonly known as White Goosefoot, is a plant species in the genus Chenopodium, belonging to the family Amaranthaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including its potential health benefits in reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Chenopodium latifolium subsp. rectum include its ability to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
